gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
The judge let him ___ with a warning.
gaps.explanation: let somebody off = not punish them, or give a light punishment.

gaps.sentence: The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.
